name: Respecting Elders
overview: Scripture commands honoring and respecting elders as a reflection of obedience to God, emphasizing the blessing that comes from honoring parents and the aged. The Old Testament instructs believers to rise before the gray-headed and to honor the elderly, recognizing their dignity as a God-given glory. The New Testament continues this call by urging children to obey their parents and all who have spiritual authority, highlighting the responsibility of leaders to care for souls with joy. Together, these verses affirm that respecting elders is both a moral duty and a spiritual principle rooted in reverence for God.
